plain: The supreme commander of a country's entire military

webster.text: The chief commander of an army or military force.

example.quote: same: he is the generalissimo of the nation, and of course, has the command and control of the army, navy, and militia; he is the general conservator of the peace of the union—he may pardon all offences, except in cases of impeachment, and the principal fountain of all offices and employments.
example.cite: Cato, Letter IV, New York Journal
